# Decks triggers

## Deck item pressed

Runs when someone presses a button on one of your decks, which are web pages of buttons you open on a phone or tablet. Good when one button should do a few things.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Deck** | Only react to buttons on this deck, by its name. Leave empty for any deck. |
| **Item** | Only react to this button, by its name. Leave empty for any button. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%deckName%` | The name of the deck |
| `%deckItemName%` | The name of the button that was pressed |
| `%deckItemState%` | The button's look now: 0 normal, 1 active |
| `%deckPage%` | Which page of the deck it was on, counting from 0 |
| `%deckPageNumber%` | Which page it was on, counting from 1 (like the page steps) |
| `%deckClient%` | Which device pressed it |
| `%deckId%` | The deck's ID |
| `%deckItemId%` | The button's ID |

<small>Type id: `decks.itemPressed`</small>
